environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in default VPC configuration (no VPC attachment), exposed via API Gateway REST API with no authorization. Lambda execution role has AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess and CloudWatchLogsFullAccess. API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible with no WAF. Lambda has 512MB memory and 30s timeout.

config.api_gateway: public REST API, no authorizer, no WAF
config.internet_access: full (no VPC means Lambda uses AWS-managed networking with internet)
